options.systemMessage:
=(Based on the pet in Prompt (User Message), generate an IMAGE PROMPT.

IMAGE PROMPT RULES (VERY IMPORTANT – STRICT ENFORCEMENT):

SCENE:

Ultra-realistic macro photograph
Real pet washing environment (bathroom, bathtub, sink, grooming station, or outdoor wash area)
Natural daylight or soft indoor lighting
Shallow depth of field
Focus on fur texture and dirt details

PET:

Selected pet is EXTREMELY dirty and believable
Fur covered in mud, dust, or grime
Tangled, wet, or clumped fur
Visible dirt patches, stains, and debris
Eyes, nose, and body proportions must be realistic
Natural expression (no cartoon or exaggeration)

HUMAN INTERACTION (MANDATORY – NO EXCEPTIONS):

One realistic adult human hand fully visible
Hand actively cleaning the pet using:
sponge OR
soft brush OR
hand scrubbing with soap
Tool (if used) must be fully visible
Clear physical contact between hand/tool and fur
CLEANING REACTION:
Soap foam forming exactly where hand touches fur
Water running through fur realistically
Dirt loosening and washing away gradually
Fur separating and becoming cleaner in contact area
No magical effects

VISUAL STYLE:

Hyper-realistic 4K
Cinematic macro shot
Realistic wet fur physics
Natural imperfections (not perfectly clean)
No logos
No text
No branding
No sci-fi elements

CRITICAL:

The hand must be physically touching and cleaning the pet, with visible foam/water interaction exactly at the contact point.

=(Based on the Prompt (User Message), generate a PROMPT for the SAME pet, SAME hand, SAME tool, SAME location.

VIDEO RULES:

FORMAT:

Vertical 9:16 (TikTok / Reels style)
8 seconds
Ultra-realistic motion
Slight handheld camera movement

SCENE:

Real pet washing environment (bathtub, sink, grooming station, or outdoor wash area)
Natural daylight or soft indoor lighting
Background slightly blurred

PET CONDITION:

Pet is extremely dirty (mud, dust, grime in fur)
Fur texture clearly visible at start (clumped, tangled, stained)

MANDATORY SEQUENCE:

Dirty pet shown in close-up
Hand enters frame
Hand makes direct contact with pet (with sponge, brush, or bare hand with soap)
Scrubbing motion clearly visible
Foam forms exactly where contact happens
Water flows through fur naturally
Dirt and mud loosen and wash away progressively
Fur becomes visibly cleaner in cleaned areas (no instant transformation)

Final result: 

cleaner, wet fur with slight remaining imperfections
Water droplets drip naturally from fur

STRICT RULES:

Hand must remain visible during cleaning
Contact between hand/tool and pet must be continuous and realistic
Foam and water must behave naturally (no excess or fake effects)
Dirt removal must follow real physics (sliding, dissolving, rinsing)
No jump cuts
No instant clean effect
No glowing or magical transitions
No exaggerated reactions from pet
No text
No logos
No branding
